blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu City will keep face-to-face classes on Tuesday, Sept. 29, despite a transport strike that could disrupt public transportation across the city. Mayor Nestor Archival confirmed on Tuesday that the city would not suspend in-person classes as transport groups proceed with their planned strike. The city government, however, has placed 15 green buses on standby to help commuters if the strike significantly affects public transportation.
